changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetDataProfileSampleJson') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSampleJson]( [ID] [BIGINT] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [AssetDataProfileID] BIGINT NOT NULL, [SampleType] NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetDataProfileSampleJson] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID], AssetDataProfileID) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetDataProfileSampleJson_AssetDataProfileID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetDataProfileSampleJson_AssetDataProfileID] ON [dbo].[AssetDataProfileSampleJson] ( [AssetDataProfileID] ASC ) END
